playa.generation: 1024 square RGBA8 map baked once; no runtime crack generation
playa.reference_photographs: Photographs guided colour and surface structure only; no photo pixels are included.
playa.channels: R linear albedo, GB normal XY, A micro-height
playa.limits: An artistic surface approximation, not a site scan or displaced ground geometry.

geometry: Burning Man uses the approved B cloths on the truss-free frame: all 212 original cloth centers, 672 geodesic tubes, 15 wooden tripod members and 215 cap/connection instances retained. Tapered spandex arms end in flat pipe sleeves. Internal aluminum trusses remain removed.

notes: Export grid spacing is not a claim of native lidar resolution.
No vertical exaggeration. Source terrain resampled for browser display.
Terrain view is contextual, not a surveyed installation placement.

burning_man_model.deprecated_predecessor: BM sphere with internal aluminum trusses
burning_man_model.deprecated_note: The previous model with internal aluminum truss towers and ring is deprecated and must not be used for new work.

default_music.fold: Channels 1,3,...29 equally to left; 2,4,...30 equally to right; each channel gain 1/15.

tube_lighting.source: Approved local HistoricalLighting assembly experiment, 27 October 2026
tube_lighting.mapping: Per-fixture source cloth axes; cyclic interpolation of shared artwork texture; no center/PCB sample on early tubes
tube_lighting.limits: Winding, chip pitch, mounting foot and tube dimensions are illustrative, with length fitted beneath the original cloth. Display halos and LED gain are artistic, not calibrated photometry.

environment_emission.source: Same 25,440 LED chip records as the visible tubes: chip positions, facing normals and angular colors.
environment_emission.limits: Spatial and directional light grouping, brightness and wood bounce are real-time approximations, without individual shadow rays or measured fixture output.

wrap_material.optics: White diffuse approximation retaining incident colour; no calibrated photometry

previous_playa_reference.treatment: Pale alkali-clay tint with reduced normal strength on a flat 50 by 50 metre plane. Representative playa appearance; not a Black Rock Desert site scan.
